name: Pre-consent tracking evidence (CIPA)
notes: Litigation-driven, undelayable. Diagnosis needs zero client data. Drift makes it recurring.

name: EU AI Act Article 50 audit
notes: Hard deadline in 3 days, but thin problem and short half-life. Door-opener, not a business.

name: Accessibility conformance (EAA/ADA)
notes: Automated tools only catch 30-40% of issues; the rest is judgment work that costs real hours.

name: PI demand packages for law firms
notes: Great ACV, but per-case QA is linear in founder time and EvenUp is compressing price.

name: NSA IDR contingency filing
notes: Huge upside but PHI/BAA gate, statutory deadlines, and active political attack on the model.

name: TiC payer rate benchmarking
notes: Cleanest legally, no PHI. But terabyte-scale data wrangling and a slower buyer.

name: Agentic commerce readiness
notes: Strong cold start, but Google shipped this audit into Lighthouse. Moat is a checklist.

name: White-label to compliance counsel
notes: Highest theoretical $/hr: solve trust-transfer 10x not 300x. But needs a product to license first.
